strings.subtitle: — File tihchhiatna —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Hruai leh tlak loh a awm lo. A hnuaia button hi hmang rawh.
strings.shred_button: T I H C H H I A T
strings.ssd_warning:
Vaukhanna! SSD-ah TRIM avangin chunga ziahna method hian tihchhiat a tiam lo.
He program hi HDD tan a ni.
strings.confirm_text:
File "{name}" chu chunga ziahin tihchhiat a ni ang.

Kalpui?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.error_cannot_read:
File chhiar theih a ni lo:
{err}
strings.report_title: ✅  FILE CHUNGA ZIAHIN TIHCHHIAT A NI
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS chher chhuah danga data stream (ADS) hi thawk a ni lo.
• USN journal hi tihthianghlim a ni lo.
• Shadow copy leh cloud sync
  (OneDrive leh dang) hi nghawng a nei lo.
strings.status_full: Chhunga thil awm zawng zawng zero-in chunga ziah a ni. Tihkir leh theih a ni lo — hmanruate chuan zero chauh an hmu ang.
strings.status_fast: Lu, mei leh 4 MB phat chunga ziah a ni. A bang la tih a ni lo, mahse kua avangin hmanrua pangngaia tihkir leh kim theih a ni lo. Lehkha thurûk tan HLAWH mode hmang rawh.
strings.status_empty: File a ruak, chunga ziah a ngai lo. Tihchhiat a ni.
strings.error_permission: File-a lut theih a ni lo. Program dangah hawn a ni mahna. Khan a, leh chhin rawh.
strings.error_not_found: File hmuh a ni lo. A hma a tihchhiat tawh a ni mahna.
strings.error_is_symlink: Hei hi symbolic link a ni. Link-te tihchhiat theih a ni lo — file tum chu a him ang.
strings.error_reparse: Hei hi hmun file (OneDrive emaw a ang) a ni. A data chu cloud-ah a awm, disk-ah a awm lo — hetah hian tihchhiat tur a awm lo.
strings.error_not_file: Hei hi file a ni lo (folder emaw thil dang). File dah rawh.
strings.error_hardlinks: He file hian hard link dang a nei ({n} zawng zawng). Hard link-te chuan lal an nei lo — hming zawng zawng a inza. Tun kawnga tihchhiat chuan, data chunga ziahin 32 byte-ah tan a ni ang, mahse a bang chu link dangin a la hmuh theih ang. A hmasain link zawng zawng tihchhiat rawh.
strings.error_compressed:
File hi pek, encrypt emaw pan a ni. Zero-in chunga ziah hian data hlui tihchhiat a tiam lo, NTFS-in kawng dangin a vawng avangin.

A nihna hlira: dinglam click → Nihna → Tihausa → "Pek" leh/emaw "Encrypt" atanga mark hlira. Chutah SHREDDER koh leh rawh.
